text:
maya (Product): quick sync — small-PRIME: propose a 'mini-surface' observability deliverable that hits dashboards + two lightweight trace hooks + a compact cost view + an error-sample export for pilot customers. aim is shipable in 2 sprints. keeping scope tight.

maya (Product): why "mini-surface": customers want signal for performance regressions and cost hotspots without us doubling telemetry spend. this slice should be low-risk to roll out and reversible.

todd (Eng-Platform): sounds reasonable. we should set a strict metric cardinality budget (e.g., +10% ingest). otherwise dashboards explode.

irene (Eng-SRE): must include at least one operational safety gate: synthetic probe and an alert throttling plan. otherwise oncall will drown in noise.

samir (Eng-Infra): two trace hooks ok: request.start and request.finish, both engineered to attach minimal metadata. request.finish can carry error flag + shape info. default sampling 0.5% for mini-surface.

liz (Solutions): pilot asks from customers: DataTailor wants cost broken down by route and feature flag, LedgerPay needs error-sample with masked user identifiers. will push them to pilot program.

nora (Security): redaction rules need to be explicit. we can include hashed user identifiers but not raw PII. also require feature-flag opt-in for any per-tenant cost breakout.

maya (Product): proposal for acceptance (draft):
- Dashboards: three panels "Latency distribution (90/95/99)", "Error rate by service", "Compact cost view (per-route, daily)" — owner: todd — max cardinality +10%
- Trace hooks: request.start, request.finish (minimal attrs) — owner: samir — sampling default 0.5%, adjustable per-tenant behind flag
- Error export: sampled traces with stack + redacted user_hash + prompt_hash for debugging — owner: liz — retention 5d
- Privacy & Security: explicit redaction rules + security review signoff — owner: nora
- Ops safety: synthetic probe runbook + alert dampening config — owner: irene
- Rollout plan: staged canary; pilot to 5 customers, auto-fallback if telemetry delta > 12% or alert noise spike > 25% — owner: maya

maya (Product): timeline: checkpoint in 10 business days (1768309999) for go/no-go. if cost estimate >15% increase, cut sampling to 0.1% and reduce retention to 3d.

todd (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: use pre-aggregated buckets for latency and avoid high-cardinality labels (no raw endpoint param values). will sketch schema + migration delta.

samir (Eng-Infra): will run an ingestion and storage estimate. also propose an early optimization: compress trace payloads and strip unused spans before storage.

irene (Eng-SRE): I'll draft the synthetic probe (warm path + cold path) and set alert thresholds. also recommend an oncall play: "obs-mini noisy alerts" with auto-mute rules for first 30m after deployment.

nora (Security): I'll prepare the redaction checklist. small ask: any new fields added to traces must be enumerated and marked as allowed/denied.

liz (Solutions): will line up two pilot customers and prepare an expectations doc: what we'll show them, what we won't. include feature-flag opt-in flow.

maya (Product): OK ACTIONS (short IDs):
- SAMIR: infra telemetry cost estimate (due 1768304200)
- TODD: dashboard schema + pre-agg POC (due 1768304300)
- IRENE: synthetic test + runbook outline (due 1768304250)
- NORA: redaction checklist + security signoff plan (due 1768304400)
- LIZ: pilot customer one-pager + opt-in flow (due 1768304500)
- MAYA: finalize mini-surface acceptance and create tickets (due 1768304600)

ops-bot: Canary quota set for 'obs-mini-surface' -> 5 pilot accounts.

todd (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup: will avoid adding new metric names if possible.

samir (Eng-Infra): noted. I'll baseline current telemetry spend and show delta.

irene (Eng-SRE): ack. will add rollback criteria to runbook.

nora (Security): ack. will coordinate with privacy before customer engage.

liz (Solutions): ack; will share customer list and NDA checklist.

maya (Product): thanks all — if no objections by EOD lock scope and ship tickets. small principle: prefer configurable knobs over new data fields. :white_check_mark:
